VERDICT: CLOSED / NULL. Five layers, no cluster-level significance anywhere. L8 and L13 sit exactly AT their attainable floors (0.125 with 4 informative clusters; 0.0625 with 5), so neither could have cleared 0.05 whatever the data. Point estimates are 4 positive and 1 NEGATIVE (L10 -0.0040), so the sign-consistency that was the last support for this line does not hold either. POWER: the design's minimum detectable effect at 80% power is ~0.03, above every effect observed here, so these nulls are uninformative about absence.
why_it_is_closed_with_an_explanation: R-27 follow-up: d_naive sits ON the exact dose-vs-cosine frontier (gap 0.0001-0.0009) while the dose_mix ladder is an INTERIOR path (gap 0.0067-0.0136). Any frontier direction sits above an interior path's curve, so 'd_naive beats every dose-matched mixture' was a fact about the construction, not the model.
preregistration_honoured: The three-way rule (both / neither / split) was fixed before the L6+L12 data and applied unrenegotiated; L13 was chosen specifically because it lies OUTSIDE the outcome-selected top-4, and its positive point estimate is reported without any significance claim, exactly as pre-committed.

power.IMPORTANT: These nulls are NOT evidence of absence. The cluster sign-flip test needs a true effect of ~0.03 for 80% power on this 495-prompt / 16-domain design, and the largest effect this comparison ever produced was +0.0222. At the observed sizes power was 0.08-0.72. The correct statement is 'not established', not 'shown absent'.
